import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_7/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_7/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Perform the join on 'calaccess_committee_id'
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="calaccess_committee_id", how="inner")

# From the joined dataframe, select and rename columns to match target schema:
# Target schema: ['contributor_firstname': string, 'contributor_lastname': string, 'amount': float]

# The joined dataframe has contributor_firstname, contributor_lastname, amount from df1
# We keep only these columns
df_target = df_joined[['contributor_firstname', 'contributor_lastname', 'amount']].copy()

# Drop rows where contributor_firstname or contributor_lastname is missing (NaN)
df_target = df_target.dropna(subset=['contributor_firstname', 'contributor_lastname'])

# Strip whitespace and uppercase contributor_firstname and contributor_lastname to match target examples style
df_target['contributor_firstname'] = df_target['contributor_firstname'].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
df_target['contributor_lastname'] = df_target['contributor_lastname'].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()

# Ensure amount is float
df_target['amount'] = df_target['amount'].astype(float)

# Save the final target table to the specified path without the index
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_7/target_multisource.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_7/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_7/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source2_7_0 and Source2_7_1 on calaccess_committee_id (inner join)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="calaccess_committee_id", how="inner")

# Select only the target columns with exact names
selected = joined[["contributor_firstname", "contributor_lastname", "amount"]]

# Group by contributor_firstname and contributor_lastname, sum the amount
result = selected.groupby(["contributor_firstname", "contributor_lastname"], as_index=False).agg({"amount": "sum"})

# Write the result to the target CSV file
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_7/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
